outcome: Expression of calpains (pre-mc-calpain, post-mc-calpain, pre-m-calpain, post-m-calpain, calpain-6)
Activated states of calpains (inactive mc-calpain, active mc-calpain)
cohort: The study participants were placentas collected from mothers with Fetal Growth Restriction (n=17) and control mothers (n=23) at elective cesarean sections.
finding: The study found that activation of mc-calpain is suppressed and calpain-6 expression is lower in FGR placentas compared to control placentas, suggesting their involvement in the pathology of FGR.
cross-section timing: At the time of elective cesarean sections
